questions.def: "Call off" means to cancel something.
questions.question: The meeting was called ___ due to unforeseen circumstances.

questions.def: "Take after" means to resemble someone.
questions.question: She takes ___ her mother in many ways.

questions.def: "Break down" means to fail or collapse.
questions.question: The negotiations ___ after several hours.

questions.def: "Cut down on" means to reduce.
questions.question: The company decided to cut ___ on expenses.

questions.def: "Look for" means to search.
questions.question: They are looking ___ a new marketing manager.

questions.def: "Carry out" means to perform or execute.
questions.question: She ___ the experiment with great precision.

questions.def: "Fill in" means to complete a form.
questions.question: Please fill ___ the application form carefully.

questions.def: "Fall through" means to fail to happen.
questions.question: The project fell ___ due to lack of funding.

questions.def: "Turn down" means to reject.
questions.question: He ___ the job offer because of the low salary.

questions.def: "Bring about" means to cause to happen.
questions.question: The new regulations will bring ___ significant changes.

questions.def: "Come across" means to find unexpectedly.
questions.question: She came ___ a rare manuscript in the library.

questions.def: "Get around to" means to finally manage to do something.
questions.question: It's difficult to ___ the new software.

questions.def: "Set out" means to begin a journey or task.
questions.question: The research team set ___ to investigate the phenomenon.

questions.def: "Sort out" means to resolve or clarify.
questions.question: We need to sort ___ the details before proceeding.

questions.def: "Look through" means to examine quickly.
questions.question: The professor ___ his notes before the lecture.

questions.def: "Stamp out" means to eliminate completely.
questions.question: The government is trying to stamp ___ corruption.

questions.def: "Stand out" means to be noticeable.
questions.question: She stood ___ from the crowd due to her height.

questions.def: "Wind down" means to gradually reduce or end.
questions.question: The company is planning to ___ its operations.

questions.def: "Back out" means to withdraw from an agreement.
questions.question: He backed ___ of the deal at the last minute.

questions.def: "Pull off" means to succeed in doing something difficult.
questions.question: The team pulled ___ a victory despite the odds.

questions.def: "Hold up" means to delay.
questions.question: The event ___ due to the bad weather.

questions.def: "Let off" means to give a light punishment.
questions.question: The suspect was let ___ with a warning.

questions.def: "Pass away" means to die.
questions.question: He passed ___ from a heart attack.

questions.def: "Hinge on" is the correct phrasal verb meaning "to depend on."
questions.question: The company's success hinges ___ a strong marketing strategy.

questions.def: "Step down from" means to resign from a position.
questions.question: After the scandal, he had to ___ his position as CEO.

questions.def: "Account for" means to explain; the passive voice is required here.
questions.question: The recent economic downturn can be ___ for by several factors.

questions.def: "Do away with" means to abolish or get rid of.
questions.question: The committee has decided to do ___ with the old regulations.

questions.def: "Work on" means to be engaged in developing something.
questions.question: The research team is ___ a new approach to cancer treatment.

questions.def: "Bear out" means to confirm the truth; bare infinitive after "asked to".
questions.question: The witness was asked to ___ out his previous statement.

questions.def: "Crack down on" means to take severe measures against something.
questions.question: The government is trying to crack ___ on tax evasion.
